description: This Java class defines the entity 'LoanTrancheDisbursementCharge' for persistence, representing charges associated with a loan tranche disbursement. It maps to the 'm_loan_tranche_disbursement_charge' database table and includes relationships to 'LoanCharge' and 'LoanDisbursementDetails'.
